entries.subject: DAMIT 1074: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1074.txt. Model 1074, version 2016-01-04, pole (284°, -14°), period 11.14849 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI AcuA
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — included as an explicitly approximate thermal size transfer. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 32.26 ± 0.36 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 226 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "16.13 km (approximate thermal scale)" (akari-acua-v1) implies a diameter of 32.26 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 159, DAMIT model 1074 diameter 27.7 ± 0.4 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 1074 fitted to 3 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
